create_test_prompts: create test prompts with various sampling parameters for offline LLM inference
process_requests: process a list of prompts through an LLM engine and handle finished request outputs
initialize_engine: initialize an LLM engine from command line arguments using EngineArgs
parse_args: parse command line arguments for LLM engine configuration using FlexibleArgumentParser
main: run the LLM engine prompt processing pipeline with test prompts and CLI arguments
